result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a protected bike lane, but pedestrian safety is compromised by large dumpsters obstructing the sidewalk and sightlines at the corner. The environment is an urban mixed-use area with one-way traffic flow and overhead signalization.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Large blue dumpsters are placed on the sidewalk near the intersection, narrowing the walking path and potentially obscuring pedestrians from drivers' view.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent the placement of dumpsters or parking too close to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Clear Zones
interventions.description: Enforce clear zones at corners by removing large objects like dumpsters to improve visibility between all road users.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility crosswalk and pedestrian signals, but lacks advanced safety measures like curb extensions or refuge islands. The presence of a vehicle stopped very close to the crosswalk creates a significant visual obstruction for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A red vehicle is stopped or parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and approaching traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, red car at the intersection

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven surfaces on both the sidewalk and the roadway near the crossing point.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk and roadway surface

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking or stopping zones within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracks and uneven surfaces to prevent trip hazards and improve accessibility.

result.summary: The image depicts an urban intersection with wide travel lanes and basic pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the lack of a pedestrian refuge island and visible pedestrian signals at the immediate crossing increases the risk for people walking.

hazards.name: Unprotected long crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk spans multiple lanes without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible at the immediate crossing to indicate when it is safe to walk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a multi-lane one-way roadway and a marked zebra crosswalk. While pedestrian signals and sidewalks are present, the long crossing distance and faded pavement markings increase exposure for pedestrians in a car-centric environment.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing exposure time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.
